claims.statement: The European Commission says the EUDAMED Actor, UDI/Device, Notified Bodies and Certificates, and Market Surveillance modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026.
Commission guidance says manufacturers must submit UDI and device information in EUDAMED for devices they place on the EU market and confirms mandatory UDI/Device-module use from 28 May 2026.

contrary_evidence: The Commission provides extensive guidance and a UDI helpdesk.
Regulatory-information-management vendors and consultants already serve established device companies.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: one authorized representative or consultant can bring ten small manufacturers onto a shared workspace.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 250 manufacturers averaging 1800 PLN monthly including device fees would produce 5.4 million PLN ARR; trusted recurring infrastructure could support founder net worth above 5 million PLN in years 6 to 9.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 20 hours weekly for one low-risk device segment, with regulatory and software-validation experts contracted.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 75% gross margin after validation support, with regulatory consulting billed separately.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 20000 PLN validated connector and channel setup repays within twelve retained manufacturer-months plus onboarding fees.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 2500 PLN onboarding per device family plus 900 PLN per manufacturer-month.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: device, label, certificate, actor, and regulatory changes repeatedly reopen master-data release.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A device-version-certificate-registration lineage graph and growing taxonomy of master-data inconsistencies
fingerprint.customer: Small EU medical-device and IVD manufacturers, authorized representatives, and regulatory consultancies
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Authorized representatives, notified-body preparation consultants, testing labs, quality-system implementers, and niche accelerators
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Validated master-data orchestration SaaS with consultant workspaces and change-control receipts
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer pays per device family onboarding and monthly for version and registration control
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A new or changed device version needs consistent master data and registration evidence before market release

founder_fit: Neuroscience, health, and data-science training support communication with device teams.
Master-data reconciliation and change detection are strong AI-assisted workflow problems.
Authorized representatives and regulatory consultants provide channel distribution.
risks: Incorrect master data can delay or compromise lawful device placement.
Users may confuse registration workflow with conformity assessment.
Security, auditability, and validation expectations may lengthen product development.

structure.control_point: Versioned UDI and EUDAMED registration receipt before internal SKU market release
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate device data, permitted system integration, and trusted regulatory partners

thesis: A release orchestrator for small EU medical-device and IVD manufacturers could reconcile Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, nomenclature, label, actor, certificate, device version, and EUDAMED receipt before a SKU is made available. It would not certify devices; it would own the master-data change gate and preserve submission lineage across manufacturers, authorized representatives, and regulatory consultants.
title: EUDAMED Device Master-Data Release Orchestrator
uncertainties: The number of small manufacturers with enough device change volume but no suitable incumbent is unknown.
EUDAMED integration routes and transition deadlines differ by device status and require verification.
The 75000 PLN capital figure and all commercial figures below are hypotheses.
